content.text:
Resubmitted with the verifier's defects repaired.

**Changes made to the inserted Section 12.11:**
1. **Narrowed the override** — "notwithstanding Section 9.7" became "notwithstanding the destruction election and timing in Section 9.7(a)-(b)", so Harpoon's one-copy retention proviso (continuing obligations, Applicable Law, litigation/archival) and automatic back-up carve-out remain intact.
2. **Confined limb (b) scope** — return is now of "all data of AbbVie", not "all data and other Confidential Information of AbbVie", matching the Customer-Data export element rather than a broader confidentiality return.
3. **Removed the contradiction with the reversion regime** — added "other than data to which Harpoon retains rights under the surviving provisions of this Agreement, including Sections 12.6 and 12.7", so the clause no longer collides with the post-termination transfer of data, know-how and regulatory materials to Harpoon.
4. **Defined-term fix** — lower-case "control" replaces the capitalised IP/licensing term "Control".

Classification remains **missing**, cured at the **fallback** level (any expiry/termination trigger; ≥90 days assistance; 30-day return anchored to the effective date), with no preferred-only extras added.
